operating_notes.text: APPCB issued a stop production order for Mori-5 well following a blowout incident on Jan 5, 2026.

ONGC engaged BP Exploration Services India Limited as Technical Services Provider for Western Offshore fields excluding Mumbai High, targeting a 24.1% increase in O+OEG production over a ten-year contract period.
ONGC declared a total dividend of ₹16,669 crore for FY26 (₹13.25 per share).
Issued postal ballot notice for RPT approvals regarding Area-1 Offshore Mozambique Project AssetCo restructuring (USD 2,440 million) and DSU amendment (USD 3,072 million).

timeline.summary: APPCB issued a stop production order for ONGC's Mori-5 well following environmental violations after a January blowout.
01 May 2026: Vivek Chandrakant Tongaonkar ceased to be Director (Finance) and CFO of ONGC w.e.f. 01 May 2026 consequent upon attaining the age of superannuation.
ONGC onboarded BP Exploration Services India Limited as Technical Services Provider to enhance production from Western Offshore fields.
ONGC reported Q4 FY26 consolidated net profit of ₹13,678 crore, up 53% YoY, and recommended a total FY26 dividend of ₹16,669 crore.
Oil & Natural Gas Corporation Limited shared the audio recording link for its 27.05.2026 conference call with analysts and investors via its website.
ONGC issued a postal ballot notice seeking shareholder approval for Mozambique Area-1 project asset restructuring and debt service undertaking extension.
ONGC submitted the transcript of its analyst and investor conference call held regarding recent financial performance.
The government approved the appointment of Sunil Kumar as Chairman for a three-year tenure starting December 2026.

upcoming_events.description: Assumption of charge by Shri Sunil Kumar as Chairman
